ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels distributed across the distal lobes and 35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields on the lateral lobe surfaces; central black pigmentation forms an irregular anchor-shaped blob with high-frequency stippling and mottling at the boundaries; several isolated black clusters are present within the white field of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 40-45 degrees; depth is clearly defined despite water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and serrated boundary; prominent high-amplitude peaks at the distal tips; moderate-frequency, lower-amplitude variations along the trailing edges of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve; initially concave relative to the median notch, transitioning to a convex sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast clusters of circular/oval anomalies localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; several dark stippled clusters present on the upper-mid region of the right lobe white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark near-vertical linear disruption on the upper-right lobe (rake mark); multiple smaller diagonal scratches visible on the medial portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant calcified clusters (barnacles) and associated physical trauma at both the left and right terminal tips; irregular trailing edge geometry suggests minor historical tissue loss at the distal margins.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct cluster of dark spots localized in the lower-right interior quadrant of the white lobe area.
